pages.text: SYN Market Wire analyst note on Imara Logistics (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 164.47 for IMA9. The note cites steady demand in the logistics sector and cost control at Imara Logistics (SYN). Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. Industry groups welcomed the clarity but asked for more investor education. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products.
